summary:

- Cross-resource relational integrity validation (verifyTaskOwnership, verifyProjectAccess, verifyGoalOwnership).
- Team workspaces, team projects, team Kanban tasks, and email invitation system.
- Automated security integration test suite (tests/security.test.ts) covering all 8 mandatory scenarios (29/29 assertions passed).
- Complete architecture documentation suite in docs/ (MULTI_USER_ARCHITECTURE.md, AUTHENTICATION.md, DATA_OWNERSHIP.md, SECURITY_TESTS.md, DATABASE_MIGRATION.md).
- Zero lint errors (tsc --noEmit) and successful compilation (npm run build).
